name: hornero
description: Role-and-skill methodology for Claude Code: PM reviewer subagent, 12 slash commands, and 54 expert-grounded skills (37 product-management skills + 17 cross-role process skills, including the cross-system `query-issue-tracker` (Linear/Jira) and `query-warehouse` (BigQuery/Snowflake) read primitives, plus three append-shaped skills — hypothesis-track, stakeholder-update, customer-update — that drive the chronicle layer's append exception). Per-role skills are exposed at the plugin-loader's flat `skills/<name>` layout via build-time symlinks. Skills opt into external data sources via their frontmatter `resources:` field — each `resources/<slug>/RESOURCE.md` card documents the MCP server install, auth env, and fallback path; Hornero stays usable when no MCP server is configured.
